newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market ends lower in bearish mood.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market ends lower in bearish mood.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market inched down on Friday as investors stayed on the sidelines expecting fresh lows for some attractive shares, traders said.
They said they expected the market to stick to that mood in the early sessions of the next week.

Unofficial index VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard Securities, slipped 0.8 percent from Thursday to 3,298.9 points. Another unofficial index, BIG-OTC, compiled by BIG brokerage house, droped by 1.33 percent to 2,337.57 points.
Some of the cement makers listed on the market, including Romcim and Romcif, maintained investor interest.
Romcim closed 1,500 lei weaker under selling pressure, while Romcif picked up 15 lei from the previous day and closed at 1,815 in heavy trading.
Oil refinery Arpechim, also a market star, gained 2,000 lei to finish at 19,500, despite a measure of volatility throughout the day, operators said.
Turnover edged down to 5.31 billion lei from 6.02 billion on Thursday on volume of 2.29 million shares.
